- [USER] User inquired about the influence of Ultima on game design trends and styles, specifically regarding open-world gameplay and character customization.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Ultima's influence on game design trends is significant, particularly in open-world gameplay and character customization.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Ultima was one of the first games to feature an open-world environment that players could freely explore.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The concept of exploration and freedom became a hallmark of the Ultima series and influenced many popular games today, such as The Elder Scrolls series, Grand Theft Auto, and The Witcher series.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Ultima was also one of the first games to offer extensive character customization options, allowing players to design their character's appearance, choose their profession, and make moral choices impacting their story and gameplay experience.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] This level of player agency and player-driven storytelling has become a popular design element in many games, such as Fallout, Mass Effect, and Dragon Age.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Ultima's influence on game design can be seen in many popular games today, and its legacy continues in new game releases.
